method: Offline Unity asset parsing with UnityPy. Shared localization keys and 64-bit IDs are joined to English tables. SerializedScriptableObject SerializationData is parsed field-by-field before the AssetId and LocalizedString name. Shapes were checked against the installed IL2CPP metadata. Full character names use the FccConfig fullName localization reference; if absent the first name is retained.
region_method: LevelSelectConfig is parsed field-by-field through its final field. BaseDungeonLevel/useBaseDungeonSettings or locationNameLoc selects the region name; LevelDungeons establishes membership. No prefix-based or filename-based region inference.
fallback: Unknown ID and shipped config without a localized name return the original ID. Unknown region returns empty. Empty/null input returns empty. Card lookup also accepts FccConfig IDs with short card names; character lookup uses full names.
limitations: Catalog coverage is the installed root *.assets files, not a claim that every item is unlocked, playable or live-tested.
Developer test configs remain included and return their serialized ID if no English label exists.
Runtime IDs are strings; numeric Unity path IDs and localization IDs are not interchangeable with game IDs.
Unknown future configurations are not guessed.
